Purchasing System

A smarter way to purchase.

Instead of juggling dozens of vendors, customs and inventory on your own, SHI consolidates the entire purchasing chain into one accountable partner — cutting lead time, cost and risk.

As-Is

Conventional purchasing

  • Dozens of scattered vendors managed one by one
  • Imports & customs handled case by case — long lead times
  • High MRO inventory tied up as safety stock
  • Quality and delivery risk with no single owner
To-Be

With SHI’s purchasing system

  • One integrated partner consolidating multiple suppliers
  • Bonded logistics (PLB) — faster clearance, steady flow
  • Local stocking & scheduled delivery — lower inventory cost
  • One accountable partner, transparent pricing end to end
